title: Too expensive
body: The books are great. However it is ridiculously overpriced to buy coins to read them.

title: Too expensive
body: Ridiculous amount of money to read stories that drag on waaay too long.

title: Quality but at a steep price
body: While the stories are interesting and often hit the spot, the cost for them is high. I can get ebooks and audiobooks cheaper other places. If Vibe Reads wants to be competitive they should reconsider their business model.

title: Too pricey
body: I was loving the book I had started but reached a point where I needed to pay for more chapters. You could buy a whole book for the price of a chapter or two. No way

title: Don’t bother unless you like paying for books
body: Costs as much as a paperback book for 1000 coins… not sure if it’s worth 8 IPhone pages for 59 coins. But no online book is worth over 10.00 start to finish! I’ll be deleting this app.

title: Costs way too much to read a book.
body: Not paying $7.99 for coins to only read a couple of chapters before I have to pay more. What a joke.

title: Nothing Free
body: Any content advertised as free takes an insane amount of coins to unlock or something and you can only get a few coins each day. Not worth the hassle. Other apps like GoodNovel, FicTopia, and Galatea let you read more chapters more easily with watching ads or waiting.

title: What a scam!
body: The book I was reading was actually great. I enjoyed many chapters then spent $7.99 to read it, only to realize that it’s only a chapter or two and they want $9.99 to read more pages! And then MORE!

title: Pay to Read?
body: No thank you. I’m not paying a fortune to buy coins to read. Just stupid
